note: Declared LLM call sites. Registered into LightTrack via `lt use-cases register`; the gap between this declaration and observed events.name is the coverage report.

use_cases.name: Recalibrate notebook edits into a script edit-plan
use_cases.description: Turns a creator's notes plus the current render table into a validated edit plan for the script.

use_cases.name: Direct scene specs from a script and notebook
use_cases.description: Turns a script and notebook into per-render scene/art-direction specs for the frames pipeline.

use_cases.name: Synthesize named styles from a foundry gallery
use_cases.description: Turns a gallery's vision-readbacks into named styles with reusable generation recipes for one foundry extract run.

use_cases.name: Draft a Sound lab hunt map
use_cases.description: Turns an operator's musical or sound-effect problem into a map of variation axes ending in concrete, renderable prompts (pipeline/SOUND-HUNT-PROMPT.md), validated before a node is kept.

use_cases.name: Draft a lesson from a finished hunt
use_cases.description: Turns a hunt's winners and losers into one drafted 'when X, brief Y, because Z' claim (pipeline/SOUND-LESSON-PROMPT.md); evidence is counted by code and a human confirms before anything is stored.

use_cases.name: Text engine availability probe
use_cases.description: Zero-token health check that walks the text engine's provider chain to report which one would serve a given turn, without generating anything.

use_cases.name: Vision-language readback for image recognition
use_cases.description: Reads back a description or structured extraction from an image for the imaging pipeline (e.g. foundry style extraction).
